evidence_shape.decision: Same original entry/plan/request and initial anchor, anchor_evidence_hash, exact actual source/binding at decision, explicit exact-field market input, freshness classification, original interpretation time/action expiry, exact original E5 EXIT action and derived stable close operation. Source/binding whole bytes are covered by evidence_hash.

required_owner_gates: Before any dispatch write transaction, use actual canonical recovery to select earliest actual positive original entry position and complete matching binding, verify original actual fill set and min(filled_at)==opened_at. Retained shape/hash plus claimed dispatch does NOT prove these facts. Storage has no canonical connection and deliberately cannot invent actualness or earliestness.

Validate first-source and decision-source existence/payload equality against actual canonical recovery and original plan/fills; require canonical graph readiness/current projection and current E6/E7 management for new interpretation/translation. Current authority is not re-required merely to deserialize historical output.

Publication is canonical persist_position_action through existing journal outside dispatch._write(), then mark receipt only after actual success or exact idempotent publication readback. Receipt itself issues no capability.

Recovery must load prior original decision/operation before fresh input/expiry gates, claimed request direct normal GET-only reconciliation. Never call stage with a fresh clock/action to renew an existing decision; no-cached PREPARED fails closed.
Common mechanical close consumer must preserve exact E5 action/reasons/bytes, not call generic authorize_close_position_action again. Existing ownership/E4 applicability/final guard remain unchanged.

schema.marker: Transaction marker is first line. Filename0024 is proposed; root verifies reservation/order before applying.
schema.fks: Migration adds unique index on existing entry(run_id,decision_id) for actual original-entry composite FK; anchor/decision/receipt reference actual generation; decision references exact anchor evidence hash; receipt references exact decision ID/evidence/effect hashes.
schema.key: All immutable keyed (run_id,entry_decision_id); decisions and receipts decision_id UNIQUE; BEFORE INSERT OR guards cover both primary-key and decision-id collisions even recursive_triggers=OFF.

known_limits: Draft is not compiled/imported or test executed. Root must perform genuine red-green owner/schema/recovery tests and independent review before use.

Storage intrinsic binding validator proves self-contained shape/projection match, not canonical execution closure completeness. Exact actual recovery comparisons remain required owner gates, not optional.

Initial immutable anchor supports current no-trailing join. Advancing trailing state is deliberately absent; no new MODIFY_PROTECTION profile.
